description: An Earth Observation image depicting a forested area in the Bavarian Forest, Germany, with signs of bark-beetle damage. The image uses a false-colour composite where healthy forest appears in shades of red, while areas affected by damage, such as bark-beetle infestation, are visible as distinct patches with greenish to bluish-grey colours. Two specific areas of damaged forest are highlighted by irregular yellow polygons in the upper right and lower left portions of the image. The surrounding red areas represent healthy forest. No scale bar, compass, or legend is visible within the image.
